node.title: Re: Reliably parsing an integer (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
What the string is: 99999999999999999999 Value of $strAsInteger: 1e+20 How printf sees it: 18446744073709551615 The results are puzzling.

Perl automatically upgrades large integers to floating point.

Perl's maximum values for integers can be determined as I showed in [id://11108835|this post].

If you want to work with integers larger than that, use [doc://Math::BigInt].

To validate number formats, use [mod://Regexp::Common::number].

Update: If two integers are the same length (or are zero-padded to be the same length), Perl's string comparisons [id://11118708|can be used].
